cli-help.txt:
usage: python -m pipe_twin [-h]
                           {inspect-model,analyze,simulate-stereo,analyze-stereo,adapt-calibration,adapt-legacy-calibration,validate-calibration,calibrate-stereo,capture-stereo,fetch-stereo,serve-capture,office-client,remote-capture,gui}
                           ...

Audit and generate traceable pipe digital-twin fixtures.

positional arguments:
  {inspect-model,analyze,simulate-stereo,analyze-stereo,adapt-calibration,adapt-legacy-calibration,validate-calibration,calibrate-stereo,capture-stereo,fetch-stereo,serve-capture,office-client,remote-capture,gui}
    inspect-model       inspect a mesh-backed 3MF, Rhino 3DM, or STL model
    analyze             analyze a manifest-bound legacy video or scheduled
                        still photos
    simulate-stereo     render deterministic stereo/depth/instance and
                        elevation truth
    analyze-stereo      analyze manifest-bound stereo still photos against a
                        CAD model
    adapt-calibration   convert OpenCV K/D/R/T plus a CAD pose to manifest
                        calibration JSON
    adapt-legacy-calibration
                        safely convert a legacy camera_config.py after
                        explicit unit and CAD pose review
    validate-calibration
                        validate a manifest-bound calibration and print repair
                        guidance
    calibrate-stereo    automatically calibrate a stereo rig from paired
                        chessboard photo folders
    capture-stereo      unattended capture of paired raw stereo PNGs from a
                        UVC camera
    fetch-stereo        download a completed remote run and verify all file
                        hashes over HTTP
    serve-capture       serve an authenticated, bounded remote stereo-capture
                        control plane
    office-client       start the office GUI together with the remote capture
                        and evidence services
    remote-capture      submit a bounded capture job to a remote capture agent
    gui                 open the local CAD-bound pipe status dashboard

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
